## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

**Key inputs**

- **prompt**: describe the shots, camera moves, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

注意：我是用的 Ultra 6000D 运行的，普通的Lite/Standard 和 Plus  运行也许会爆显存。
运行结束后，右侧的任务列表也许也会显示任务失败，但你可以通过在上方的两个Video Output窗口，点击右键选择 “Save preview” 保存生成结果到本地。

<Picture 1> and <Picture 2> as character references, <Picture 3> as background reference, <Audio 1> as reference audio.

SHOT 1: 0-4 seconds. <Picture 1> (Red-clad woman) and <Picture 2> (Black-clad woman) engage in intense, high-speed close-quarters martial arts combat in the rain-slicked alleyway of <Picture 3>. <Picture 2> launches a fierce, aggressive combination of high kicks and straight punches. <Picture 1> elegantly yet powerfully parries, dodges, and counters with fluid martial arts blocks and joint locks. Water splashes dramatically from puddles with every impact. The camera uses dynamic handheld tracking to follow their rapid exchanges, maintaining both characters in frame.

SHOT 2: 5-8 seconds. <Picture 1> exploits a momentary opening in <Picture 2>'s defense, executing a powerful spinning back kick or sweeping throw that forces <Picture 2> to stumble backward. <Picture 2> struggles to regain her balance in the mid-ground, panting heavily, and attempts one last desperate lunge forward. <Picture 1> remains composed in the foreground, shifting her weight and preparing for the final decisive strike. Camera performs a smooth, dramatic push-in towards <Picture 1>, building tension.

SHOT 3: 9-10 seconds. In this final 1 second only, <Picture 1> unleashes a lightning-fast, devastating finishing move (a precise sweeping leg strike or powerful grappling takedown). <Picture 2>'s defense is completely broken, and she is forcefully knocked off her feet, crashing heavily onto the wet ground in the background, creating a massive splash. <Picture 1> immediately transitions into the exact dominant, victorious standing pose shown in the last frame reference, looking down with a cold, confident smirk as her red coat settles elegantly.
